selected_reviews_for_site.trimmed_text: After months of struggling with constant neck pain and visiting several doctors and physiotherapists, I was almost ready to give up. Then I tried personal training with Manoj at Daemon Strength. He designed a rehab plan specifically for my neck pain while also adding strength training. His deep understanding of biomechanics made every session both safe and effective. In just 30 days, I was doing full pushups with excellent form.

Even though I was working out regularly in the Netherlands, I wasn't seeing any real changes. Manoj bhaiya was the fastest bowler in Rajasthan and recently opened Daemon Strength. With his 15 years of experience in fitness and sports, I gave it a shot. I got a custom workout plan, strength training, and a weight gain strategy. I gained 7kg in the first 30 days alone.

This isn't your typical commercial gym — it's a no-nonsense, results-driven space. Manoj's approach is personalized, science-backed, and brutally effective. His knowledge of biomechanics, nutrition, and performance training is unmatched. The gym is well-equipped with everything from powerlifting rigs and strongman tools to conditioning gear.

Trainer Manoj sir is very dedicated for his clients. For me he is the best personal trainer. I am getting regular HIT sessions and as per his guidance I have lost 12kg in the last 3 months. Surely recommend if you want to lose or gain weight.

I started here because I didn't feel comfortable in crowded gyms — I needed proper 1-on-1 personal training. When I started, Manoj focused on very basic exercises and gradually progressed. After 3 months I can lift much heavier weights. I also had a slight shoulder injury and he built a customized shoulder recovery rehab plan around it.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Vish Agarwal
all_google_reviews_raw.text: I joined Daemon Strength Gym in Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, and I'm genuinely impressed with the overall experience. The gym is extremely well-equipped, clean, and perfectly maintained. It has all the modern machines, free weights, and functional training setups that anyone beginner or advanced would need. A special mention for trainer Manoj Datic, who has been my personal trainer for the past few weeks. He truly understands body mechanics, strength training techniques, and individual fitness goals.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Priyanka Gupta
all_google_reviews_raw.text: After months of struggling with constant neck pain and visiting several doctors and physiotherapists, I was almost ready to give up. Then I decided to try personal training with Manoj Datic at Daemon Strength Gym. He designed a rehab plan specifically for my neck pain while also adding strength training and weight loss strategies. In just 30 days, I was doing full pushups with excellent form. Daemon Strength has a female-friendly environment, promoting empowerment and safety for everyone.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Keshav Aggarwal
all_google_reviews_raw.text: A few years back, I had the chance to train with Manoj Datic, and it was one of the best decisions for my fitness journey. He guided me with proper form, diet tips, and a balanced routine. His approach is practical, motivating, and customized to your fitness level.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Gaurav Sadhwani
all_google_reviews_raw.text: Great personal training gym in Vaishali Nagar! Supportive trainer, clean space, and workouts perfectly tailored to my goals. It's one of the best weight loss studios around, and Manoj Datic is truly one of the best personal trainers in Jaipur.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Rubaina Nagpal
all_google_reviews_raw.text: If you're serious about transforming your body, building real strength, or simply leveling up your fitness game, Daemon Strength Gym is where you want to be. The gym is well-equipped with everything from powerlifting rigs and strongman tools to conditioning gear. It's raw, intense, and built for those who are hungry to put in the work.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Manish Samota
all_google_reviews_raw.text: Manoj Datic Bhaiya was the fastest bowler in Rajasthan and recently opened the Daemon Strength Gym in Vaishali Nagar. With his 15 years of experience in fitness & sports I decided to give it a shot. I gained 7kg in the first 30 days alone. Kiran mam, the co-owner, runs special classes for women's personal training.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Hemant Kumar
all_google_reviews_raw.text: Trainer Monoj sir is very dedicated for his clients, for me he is the best personal trainer. I am getting regular HIT sessions and as per his guidance I have lose 12kg weight in last 3 months.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: dark gaming
all_google_reviews_raw.text: Best Gym and training experience so far. There are very few coaches and trainers who teach like this and it was my pleasure to learn a lot under your humble guidance @Manoj Sir.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Manmohan Saraswat
all_google_reviews_raw.text: Best place for sports injury in Jaipur. I was struggling with lower back pain, but after joining Daemon Strength I've seen real improvement in my recovery. Manoj sir is very supportive and focuses on proper technique.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Prateek Sain
all_google_reviews_raw.text: Best gym in Jaipur, specially Manoj who helped me reduce 30 kg weight without any marketing supplements except protein powder. Just a best workout and healthy homemade diet.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Yashwardhan Singh Rathore
all_google_reviews_raw.text: After training here for 3 months I can say that it is the best personal training centre in Vaishali Nagar Jaipur. I was specifically looking for the best gym where I could get proper 1-on-1 personal training because I didn't feel comfortable in crowded gyms.

all_google_reviews_raw.author: Yuvpartap Singh
all_google_reviews_raw.text: I'm an IT professional and have been struggling with balance, stability, and physical weakness. Manoj Bhaiya (owner) understood my physical condition and tailored my workout and diet accordingly. In just one month, I'm seeing significant improvement in my stability and recovery.
